title: CircuitResult
description: Output schema for qx_run_circuit / Engine.run_circuit. All fields are append-only.

ok.description: True on success; false when an error_code is set.

backend.description: Name of the backend that executed the circuit.

engine_version.description: Semantic version of the QuantX engine.

state_size.description: Number of amplitudes in the final statevector.

counts.description: Shot-based bitstring counts keyed by big-endian bitstring.

expectation_exact.description: Exact <psi|O|psi> values keyed by observable label.

expectation_shot.description: Shot-based expectation estimates keyed by observable label.

estimation_error.description: Difference between shot and exact expectation values.

error_summary.description: Aggregate error statistics: mean_abs_error, max_abs_error, num_observables.

measurement_results.description: Classical register outcomes from MEASURE operations (clbit index order).

error_code.description: Machine-readable error code when ok=false (e.g. QX_UNSUPPORTED_GATE).

error.description: Alias of error_message for backward compatibility.
